_comment: Which screens each release claims to have changed, and where.
The pixel gate used to require all twelve screens to move on every
release. That was right for 10.6.x/10.7.0, which were explicitly
'rearrange every screen' releases, and wrong as a standing rule: a
release that deliberately touches four screens would have to churn the
other eight or fail — which is the dishonesty the gate exists to catch,
A release lists the screens it claims to have changed. Claimed screens
are gated exactly as before. Unclaimed screens are still measured and
printed, so an unintended change is visible, but do not fail the run.
A version with no entry here is gated on all twelve — forgetting to
write a claim makes the gate stricter, never weaker.
'region' narrows the comparison to [x0, y0, x1, y1] as fractions of the
image. Use it when a screen carries an animated element that dominates a
whole-image delta: naming where the change is makes the claim more

_why: Tight Ship release: deletions, consolidation and front-door fixes —
backend only. The frontend bundle is untouched; no captured screen
changes on purpose. All thirteen measured but not gated. Known
jitter: 05-memory-graph moves ~2-3% between captures from the
cytoscape layout (11.3.0-11.5.1 observed).
Rust Full Loop release: agent-loop orchestrator port, worker seams,
doc-gen context builder — backend only. The frontend bundle is
untouched; no captured screen changes on purpose. All thirteen
measured but not gated. Known jitter: 05-memory-graph moves ~2-3%
between captures from the cytoscape layout (11.3.0-11.5.0 observed).
Rust Complete release: backend/desktop-topology architecture only
(router mounts, front-door default, scheduler, safety kernel). The
frontend bundle is untouched; no captured screen changes on purpose.
All thirteen measured but not gated. Known jitter: 05-memory-graph
moves ~2-3% between captures from the cytoscape layout (observed at
11.3.0 and 11.4.0 with zero source change).
Rust Foundation release: backend architecture only (rust/ workspace,
supervisor, native search gateway). No intentional change to any
captured screen — the frontend bundle is untouched. All thirteen are
measured but not gated; 13-chronicle.png now has a v11.3.0 baseline.
Known jitter: 05-memory-graph moves ~2-3% between captures from the
cytoscape layout, with zero source change (also observed at 11.3.0).
Chronicle release. 13-chronicle.png is NEW this release (no baseline
in v11.2.0 — the pixel gate reports it as 'new' and cannot diff it).
The No Big Files track proved the CSS bundle byte-identical, so the
only deliberate pixel change on existing screens is the everyday nav's
fourth item (연대기). Measured on capture: at the capture viewport the
shell nav is visible on 05-memory-graph (2.65% moved, claimed below);
the other shells render the nav collapsed or unchanged (0.00–0.07%),
so they are measured but not claimed.
The dock rail gained a fourth item (기능) opening the feature-toggle
drawer. The rail change itself is small; the LivingBrain animation
noise threshold (8%) may exceed it, so the screen is claimed with the
rail region only.
Feature release with no intentional change to the twelve captured
screens: the new surfaces (proposals, thumbnails) render inside
existing panels and the capture corpus carries no image citations.
All twelve measured but not gated.
Defect-fix and branch-coverage release: no intentional UI change.
No screen claims layout movement; all twelve are measured but not
gated. Visible pixels may drift only where the version renders.
A verification-and-docs release: Python coverage 72.80% -> 100.00%
(fail_under=100) with no UI change. No screen claims layout movement;
all twelve are measured but not gated. Visible pixels may still drift
where the version string renders.

04-brain-chat-home.png._why: Elevated brain-chat-home visual layout with glassmorphic station card, ambient radial mesh aura, gradient title, glowing dot prompt cards, and refined toolbar styling.

_why: The quiet-station redesign: the memory stats left the hero sentence
for a hover badge, the six capture chips folded behind the composer's
+ control, the model banner became a status pill on the hero's right,
the two bottom shelves became a dock rail (대화 · 통계 · 기억 지도),
cards dropped their borders for soft shadows, and the accent colour
was pulled back to the send CTA and the model action.
This release claims no screen redesign, and the empty claim is the
honest statement of that: 10.9.0 is a correctness release (event-loop
blocking, a focus ring that faded in too slowly to see, an organism
stuck in 'thinking', localized server errors).
Its two visual changes are both invisible at the capture viewport by
construction. The welcome step's compaction lives under
`@media (max-height: 820px)` and captures run at 1440x900; the capture
pills' focus border only differs while an input inside them has focus,
which no screenshot holds. The visual suite asserts both directly
instead — `tests/visual/v3.home.spec.js` pins the welcome height and
`tests/visual/v3.surfaces.spec.js` pins the focus border — because a
pixel diff is the wrong instrument for either.
